metadata.title: Dell Technologies Stock Pick: It’s Time to Sell<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Dell Stock Has Doubled Since Our Initial Pick. Now It’s Time to Sell.
Our stock pick of Dell Technologies has performed exceptionally well since we initially picked it, though we feel we’ve overstayed our welcome.
